description: Manny the Manticore, the studio front door: onboarding, ideas into projects, footage-first arrivals, routing, craft coaching. Start here when unsure.

First-run and any-time configuration: dependency checks, the onboarding interview (render consent, video style, CTAs, audio lanes), brand and voice-bible builds, tool registration, 0.x migration. Everything else routes here until the studio config exists. On the Resolve lane it checks for Resolve Studio, validates the Resolve preset names, and offers Blackmagic's MCP.
Where is my project, what's next, route to the right stage. The master stage/gate contract; always the source of truth for project state.

Scaffold a project from a format profile: idea-first, or footage-first ingest for an existing recording or livestream VOD (post-production stage list starting at cut). Series and deadline modes. Creates the video's Resolve project when the editor is Resolve.
Interview that captures the idea in the creator's exact words, verbatim. Camera-rolling mode turns the interview itself into usable footage.
3 hooks plus one outline plus the packaging promise. GATE 1: hard stop for creator approval. Footage-first projects skip the write phase entirely.
Weave the script from the creator's own braindump words, lint against the blacklist, craft QA. The creator records it however they always record.

Verified word-level transcript, audio-based cut with dead-air tightening, and an editorial pass that recommends content cuts. GATE 2: hard stop on both the mechanical and content calls. Every approval produces a validated preview render and the editor timeline export; the final-quality render is offered at gate 4. On the Resolve lane it imports the cut into Resolve with review markers and renders the gate 4 final there.

Riff treatment ideas with the creator, then the beat table anchored to spoken words under creativity mandates and the density tier, with the CTA placement pass. GATE 3: hard stop. On the Resolve lane the table also lands on the cut timeline as markers.

Execute the approved beat table in HyperFrames / HTML / design-prompting; frame-verified alpha overlays plus an editor HANDOFF. On the Resolve lane it places the graphics and editable Fusion titles in Resolve.
Source and farm the stills and b-roll the beat table calls for through registered CLI tools (metered APIs opt-in), real verified imagery first.

Service skill, no stage or gate: local-first TTS narration and two-host dialogue (Kokoro-82M), instrumental beds (MusicGen-small), SFX (AudioLDM2). Called from graphics, stream packs, and voiceover narration, or directly.

Titles, thumbnails verified at 120px, description, CTAs, dual-timeline chapters, SRT/VTT captions and a publishable transcript from the edited timeline, series A/B pairs, live-event mode. May start any time after gate 1; offer it during dead time between stages. On the Resolve lane it builds captions, thumbnail frames and chapters from the Resolve timeline.
A complete branded livestream asset pack for OBS (scenes, stinger, lower thirds) from brand tokens; the livestream-pack format lane.

After publishing: one round of notes edits the format profile, the bibles, and the brand files so the next video starts smarter, then the post-publish wrap. On the Resolve lane it first diffs the finished Resolve timeline against the cut.
